name: Lychee
tagline: A free photo-management tool, which runs on your server or web-space. Installing is a matter of seconds. Upload, manage and share photos like from a native application. Lychee comes with everything you need and all your photos are stored securely.
description: Lychee is a free photo-management tool, which runs on your server or web-space. Installing is a matter of seconds. Upload, manage and share photos like from a native application. Lychee comes with everything you need and all your photos are stored securely.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/lychee:7.12.0@sha256:e5f34f152040a876e638b4e1a6ab1abb6bdb47984b9f87a37caa74b95e2f1645
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      DB_CONNECTION: $DB_CONNECTION
      DB_HOST: $DB_HOST
      DB_PORT: $DB_PORT
      DB_USERNAME: $DB_USERNAME
      DB_PASSWORD: $DB_PASSWORD
      DB_DATABASE: $DB_DATABASE
      APP_NAME: $APP_NAME
      APP_URL: $APP_URL
      TRUSTED_PROXIES: $TRUSTED_PROXIES
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/pictures
        target: /pictures
notes: Configure the required database, application name, and URL settings before installing. This app requires an external database and will not start with empty defaults.
